_doc: dissolve (0x414f81) tables. Pass p (0..15) copies, for every pair of rows r = 0, 2, 4 ... (h - 1), the 2 x 2 blocks at x = (-row_order[r % 16]) + 16 n + column_order[p] that lie in 0 <= x < w - 2; a FlushRect of the whole box follows each pass; one final full copy + flush ends it. Over the 16 passes column_order visits every residue mod 16 once.
